gloss: sale day; special-offer day; bargain day

definitions.gloss: sale day; special-offer day; bargain day
definitions.explanation: A specific day on which a shop, supermarket, or department store sells selected items at reduced prices. Often held on fixed days of the week or month.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{特売日|とくばいび}だ。
{特売日|とくばいび}は{店内|てんない}が{混|こ}んでいる。
examples.english: The store is crowded on sale days.

examples.japanese: {毎週|まいしゅう}{水曜日|すいようび}は{野菜|やさい}の{特売日|とくばいび}なので、まとめて{買|か}いに{行|い}く。
examples.english: Every Wednesday is the vegetable sale day, so I go shopping in bulk.

notes:
Compound of {特売|とくばい} (special sale) + {日|び} (day). Most often refers to weekly or monthly sales at supermarkets, with categories like 'meat day,' 'vegetable day,' or 'tenth-of-the-month sale.'

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {毎週|まいしゅう}{特売日|とくばいび}: weekly sale day
- {野菜|やさい}の{特売日|とくばいび}: vegetable sale day
- {特売日|とくばいび}に{買|か}いに{行|い}く: to go shopping on sale day

SIMILAR WORDS:
- セール: sale (general loanword)
- {特売|とくばい}: special sale (the discount itself)
- バーゲンセール: bargain sale (often for clothing)
- {大売|おおう}り{出|だ}し: big sale event
